text: Can't believe we agreed to this weird challenge~.\nSince something like a child's craft counts as a\ntreasure too, let's go find materials to make one!
Hmm, a "Gemstone Branch"...\nThat means we need a huge branch~! Let's beat the\nmonsters there and get it from them!
I think we've got a good one!\nNext, the gemstones...Maybe it's impossible.\nLet's just find some nice stones for it!
But it'll be difficult if we carry this branch\naround. Let's leave it here and come back for it\nlater!
Hmm, this branch looks pretty good...\nIt's exactly the kind of thing I need.
Once we find the gemstones, all we need to do is\nput them together nicely! Hop! Lady Kaguya, wait\nfor it!
We've finally got everything we need~!\nLet's attach them to that branch...\nOh, where is it?!
The huge branch we put here is gone!\nD-don't tell me it got stolen!
That's Kaguya's voice, right?!\nI'm curious, let's go check it out!
Hey, wait!\nWe haven't got everything we need!
